### [`level_row_delays`](../../../../src/engine/row_delay.asm#L6) `$8065-$8069`

*data*

Delay after each scanned row, one byte for each level 1-5. A larger value gives a slower game.

- **Read by:** [`init_cave_state`](../cave/setup.md#init_cave_state) [`$8299`](../../../../src/cave/setup.asm#L64)
